comment.body: Thanks for the concrete report about CmdPal: Battery indicator is unavailable when perfmon is soft-disabled, including the version, affected PowerToys area, and observed behavior. The remaining ambiguity is the exact failing path or whether this still reproduces on a current build, so a generic checklist would not help. Please compare battery behavior in the same Command Palette build with Performance Monitor enabled, manually disabled, and soft-disabled after a failure, naming the missing battery command or indicator and the expected result. This will distinguish the competing triage paths and determine whether the proposed fix should target the reported behavior or a different configuration or lifecycle condition.
